test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is true about the Yaoshang Festival in Manipur?

options.text: Thabal Chongba is a moonlight circle dance
Pala Eshei sung by unmarried youths
Marks the start of harvest season

solution:
The correct answer is __**Thabal Chongba is a moonlight circle dance**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 

__ 
 
• **Yaoshang Festival** is one of the most important festivals celebrated in Manipur, India, and lasts for six days starting from the full moon day of the Hindu month of Phalguna (February–March). 
 
• The festival features the traditional dance known as **Thabal Chongba**, which is performed in moonlight by groups of young people. 
 
• Thabal Chongba is a symbolic dance representing joy, unity, and social bonding within the community during the festival. 
 
• The term "Thabal Chongba" translates to "moonlight dance," where participants form a circle and dance to rhythmic folk music. 
 
• Yaoshang Festival is marked by various cultural programs, sports activities, and local folk performances, promoting harmony and community spirit among the people of Manipur. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

 
 
• **Pala Eshei sung by unmarried youths:** 

 
 
• Pala Eshei is a form of devotional song performed during the Yaoshang Festival. 
 
• It is sung by groups of people, including unmarried youths, who go from house to house in a traditional way. 
 
• The songs are dedicated to Lord Krishna and are aimed at seeking blessings and spreading cultural harmony. 
 
• However, it is not the primary or defining feature of the Yaoshang Festival, unlike Thabal Chongba. 
 
 

 
• **Includes academic quiz competitions:** 

 
 
• While the Yaoshang Festival is known for its vibrant cultural and sports activities, academic quiz competitions are not a traditional or defining feature of this festival. 
 
• The focus of the festival lies in fostering community bonding through folk dances, sports, and rituals. 
 
 

 
• **Marks the start of harvest season:** 

 
 
• The Yaoshang Festival does not mark the beginning of the harvest season; instead, it is celebrated as a spring festival. 
 
• The festival is more about cultural and social activities, including the celebration of nature, traditional dances, and sports. 
 
• Harvest season festivals in India are typically associated with other celebrations like Pongal in Tamil Nadu or Baisakhi in Punjab. 
 
 

 
• **Main theme of Yaoshang Festival:** 

 
 
• The Yaoshang Festival is primarily a celebration of the vibrant cultural heritage of Manipur. 
 
• It incorporates religious elements, as devotees visit temples and offer prayers to Lord Krishna. 
 
• Community engagement through sports and folk performances is an essential feature of this six-day festival.
